This chapter and the next together survey the scene in India from the end of the Gupta era about 600 CE to about 1200 CE.
These six centuries together have received several names — ‘post-classical’, ‘late classical’ and ‘early medieval’ among others.
We need not use any of those terms here, as long as we keep the broad chronology in mind.
